login.title: Sign in - PAT Monitor
onb.enable-failed: Access from outside could not be turned on.
onb.exp.also-body: It is not a part of PAT Monitor: it is a real VPN, and it stays yours. With the same network you can reach the files on your home computer from outside, link two houses together, or print at home from wherever you are. If you do not need any of that, you need do nothing: the monitor works just the same.
onb.exp.also-title: And you can use it for other things
onb.exp.art: The monitor and the device you watch from both call the same meeting point; then video and audio travel directly between them
onb.exp.caption: Only the page and the introduction between the two go through the meeting point, a few kilobytes. The video takes the short way.
onb.exp.short-road: The room does not go through the meeting point: the page does, and the few lines the two use to introduce themselves. The video takes the short way, encrypted end to end: neither Tailscale nor we can see it.
onb.exp.vpn: Tailscale is a VPN, a private network between your own devices. Usually, to be reachable from outside, you open a port on the router: anyone passing by finds that port. Here it is the other way round — the monitor calls out, and the device you watch from calls the same meeting point. They recognise each other there, and from then on video and audio travel straight between the two.
onb.failed-count: the monitor is running at home
onb.no-answer: The monitor is not answering. Trying again.
onb.page-error: The page hit an error and stopped. Reload it.
onb.prev.not-ready: the camera is not sending images yet
onb.pw.changed-no-login: Password changed, but signing back in failed. Reload the page.
onb.pw.set-no-login: Password set, but signing in failed. Reload the page.
onb.reset.lead: The rest of the setup is as you left it. Once you choose, you go back to the monitor.
onb.reset.title: Choose a new password
onb.s0.art: A closed padlock beside the monitor’s window
onb.s0.caption: Every device you watch the room from asks for it.
onb.s0.change-note: Changing it disconnects the devices that are connected. This page signs itself back in.
onb.s0.have-enter: It was set earlier. Enter it to carry on: from here the setup shows you what the camera really sees.
onb.s0.have-keep: It was set earlier. You can keep it and move on, or change it here.
onb.s0.lead: It protects access to what the camera sees and hears. Until you choose one, nobody can reach the monitor.
onb.s0.note: The password is stored only as a fingerprint, never in the clear. Not even the program can read it back: if you forget it, you reset it from the computer the monitor runs on.
onb.s0.title: First of all, a password
onb.s1.art: A camera with its light on, and a microphone whose level moves
onb.s1.cam-bad-detail: No images coming in. Check that no other program is using it.
onb.s1.cam-denied-detail: Windows is not letting this program use the camera. Camera access is turned back on in Settings › Privacy & security › Camera, for desktop apps too.
onb.s1.cam-detail: {res} at {fps} frames per second, compressed by {enc}
onb.s1.cam-detail-gpu: {res} at {fps} frames per second, compressed by the graphics card
onb.s1.caption: Below, the video says whether it sees and the bar whether it hears: it moves when you speak.
onb.s1.lead: These are the two things that must work whatever else you do. Watching from outside comes later, and it is optional.
onb.s1.mic-bad-detail: The bar under the video stays still. On a laptop this happens when you close the lid: the microphones go, the camera does not.
onb.s1.mic-denied-detail: Windows is not letting this program use the microphone. Microphone access is turned back on in Settings › Privacy & security › Microphone, for desktop apps too.
onb.s1.mic-filtered: Careful: the noise reduction filter could not be turned off. Crying may come through muffled.
onb.s1.mic-raw: The microphone is read before the noise reduction filter, which would otherwise cancel a baby’s crying too.
onb.s1.title: Let’s see whether it sees and hears
onb.s1.warn: If one of the two stops, the other carries on. A microphone that is missing does not switch the picture off, and a camera that will not open does not switch off the sound. The monitor says which of the two it is, instead of leaving you a silent room to interpret.
onb.s2.art: Two options: at home only, or from outside as well
onb.s2.change-mind: You can change your mind whenever you like: the setting stays in the icon next to the clock.
onb.s2.lead: At home the monitor is ready already: it shows on any phone, tablet or computer on the same wifi, and the address is on the last screen. Watching from outside takes a few more minutes, once.
onb.s2.objections: It needs Tailscale, a service free for personal use. No new password: you sign in with an account you already have — Google, Microsoft or Apple. Nothing changes on your router, and there is nothing to install on the device you watch from.
onb.s2.title: Do you need to watch from outside too?
onb.s3.addr-waiting: One moment — asking Tailscale for the address…
onb.s3.art: A browser window where this computer is recognised and authorised
onb.s3.lead: Open the address below: you will be asked to sign in with Google, Microsoft, Apple or GitHub, and then to confirm with a button that this computer is yours.
onb.s3.not-admitted: The device is there, but it has not been admitted yet.
onb.s3.note: The device will appear in the Tailscale list as soon as you open the address, and it will be off. That is normal: it comes on once the authorisation has gone through. Seeing it in the list does not mean it is done, and this page does not move on until it really is.
onb.s3.qr-alt: Scan this code to open the address on your phone
onb.s3.qr-hint: Phone in hand and the monitor on another computer? Scan the code: it leads to the same address, and there is nothing to do on the computer.
onb.s3.title: Authorise this computer
onb.s3.waiting: Waiting for the confirmation. As soon as it arrives, this page moves on by itself. If the monitor restarts meanwhile, the address above changes: only the latest one works, and any dead devices left in the list are removed by hand.
onb.s3.will-be-off: It will show as off in the list: that is normal until it is admitted. As soon as that happens, this page moves on by itself.
onb.s4.admin: Open the address, confirm, and come back here. This page notices by itself.
onb.s4.art: A switch turning on and a gate opening in front of the meeting point
onb.s4.from-tailscale: The message above comes from Tailscale, we did not write it: it changes with your account and your role in the network.
onb.s4.lead: The computer is part of your Tailscale network, but the network is not yet allowed to take visits from the Internet. It is a setting for the whole network, given once.
onb.s4.member: This happens when the account you used belongs to somebody else’s network, typically your employer’s. If the monitor is a home thing, the simplest way out is to sign out and back in with a personal account: the network will be yours and you grant the permission yourself.
onb.s4.missing-permission: A permission is missing on the Tailscale network.
onb.s4.skip-tail: and use the monitor at home only.
onb.s4.title-admin: One permission is missing, and it is one click
onb.s4.title-member: One permission is missing, and you cannot grant it
onb.s4.waiting: Waiting. As soon as the permission is there, this page moves on by itself.
onb.s5.art: A padlock closing while a waiting arc fills up
onb.s5.lead: It is what keeps what you watch from outside encrypted. An external authority issues it and it can take up to a minute: it happens once in the monitor’s life.
onb.s5.nothing: Nothing to do: this page moves on by itself.
onb.s5.title: Preparing the secure connection
onb.s5.why: If this wait were left to the first connection, whoever connects would find a page that does not answer and would think the monitor is broken. We pay it now, while you are at the screen and know what is going on.
onb.s6.away-note: At the address above, with the password you chose. From any phone, tablet or computer, with nothing to install
onb.s6.done-home: The camera and the microphone are on, and you can watch from any device on your home wifi.
onb.s6.done-out: And you can watch from any network, encrypted end to end, without having opened a single port on your router.
onb.s6.first-wait: The first time it can take a few minutes. The address name has to be registered on the Internet, and the same wait comes back after the monitor has been off for a while. If it does not open from your phone straight away, try again in a few minutes.
onb.s6.home-note: Always available, even if the Internet goes down
onb.s6.qr-away: Scan it with your phone and save the link to your bookmarks: you will not have to look for it again.
onb.s6.qr-away-alt: Scan this code to open the monitor on your phone
onb.s6.qr-home: Scan it with your phone and save the link to your bookmarks. It works from any device on your home wifi. If one day it stops opening, the address has changed: the current one is always in the icon next to the clock.
onb.s6.qr-home-alt: Scan this code to open the monitor on a phone at home
onb.s6.title: The monitor is on
onb.s6.tray-art: The monitor’s icon in the taskbar, next to the clock, with the panel the right button opens above it
onb.s6.tray-body: You can close this page. The monitor keeps running and stays within reach in the icon next to the clock: from there you see whether all is well and how many people are watching, you copy the address, and you change the few settings there are.
onb.s6.tray-caption: The colour of the icon says how it is doing, without opening anything.
onb.s6.tray-title: From now on the monitor lives here
onb.s6.who-enters: Anyone with the address and the password gets in. The address is not a secret: the password is, and that is the door. Save the link to your bookmarks, or to your phone’s home screen, and you will not have to look for it again.
onb.s7.art: The link to the outside is broken, while the one at home is intact
onb.s7.home-ok: The monitor works normally at home. You can keep using it over wifi: nothing you have done has been lost.
onb.s7.retry-hint: Usually another try is enough: the step that fails often depends on an external service that is momentarily busy.
onb.s7.tech-why: Useful if you need to ask someone for help or look the error up.
onb.s7.title: Access from outside did not open
onb.session-expired: Session expired. Reload the page and sign in with the password.
setup.hint: Until you set a password the monitor is unreachable, and it cannot be published to the Internet. The password is stored only as an argon2id hash, never in plain text.
